## Calculate heritability per TE 
```{r}
sampledata <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/10_metadata/tm3_phenotype_preprocessed_based_on_pca_with_selfers_v2.csv",header=T)
sampledata <- sampledata %>% dplyr::select(Sample_id,Accession,Variant,Genotype,Replicate)
# Join with reads
reshaped_data_with_sampleinfo <- left_join(expression_cleaned_tes,sampledata, by=c("Sample_id"="Sample_id", "Accession", "Variant", "Genotype"))
## Get only maternal genome 
expression_cleaned_tes_maternal <-reshaped_data_with_sampleinfo[reshaped_data_with_sampleinfo$genome=="tair10",]
## Create acc var
expression_cleaned_tes_maternal$acc_var <- paste(expression_cleaned_tes_maternal$Accession,expression_cleaned_tes_maternal$Variant, sep="_")

## Get TEs with problematic structure
# Check your data structure
expression_cleaned_tes_maternal %>%
  filter(Variant %in% c("Col", "ddm1")) %>%
  group_by(ID, Variant) %>%
  summarise(
    n_obs = n(),
    n_accessions = n_distinct(acc_var),
    n_replicates = n_distinct(Replicate),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(n_obs)



# Identify TEs with sufficient data in BOTH variants
tes_to_keep <- expression_cleaned_tes_maternal %>%
  filter(Variant %in% c("Col", "ddm1")) %>%
  group_by(ID, Variant) %>%
  summarise(
    n_obs = n(),
    n_accessions = n_distinct(acc_var),
    n_replicates = n_distinct(Replicate),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # Keep only TEs where BOTH variants have sufficient data
  filter(
    n_obs > n_accessions,      # More observations than accessions
    n_replicates >= 2          # At least 2 replicates
  ) %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  filter(n() == 2) %>%          # Must be present in both variants
  pull(ID) %>%
  unique()


expression_cleaned_tes_maternal_filtered <- expression_cleaned_tes_maternal %>%
  filter(ID %in% tes_to_keep)

## At least 2 replicates within each condition

# Identify accessions with >=2 replicates per variant
accessions_to_keep <- expression_cleaned_tes_maternal_filtered %>%
  group_by(Accession, Variant) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_replicates = n_distinct(Replicate), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(n_replicates >= 2) %>%
  group_by(Accession) %>%
  filter(n() == 2) %>%  # Must have >=2 replicates in BOTH variants
  pull(Accession) %>%
  unique()

# Filter the dataframe
expression_cleaned_tes_maternal_filtered <- expression_cleaned_tes_maternal_filtered %>%
  filter(Accession %in% accessions_to_keep)

# Check results
cat("Accessions kept:", length(accessions_to_keep), "\n")
cat("Total rows:", nrow(expression_cleaned_tes_maternal_filtered), "\n")


```


```{r}

## Calculate heritability 
heritability <- expression_cleaned_tes_maternal_filtered %>%
  filter(Variant %in% c("Col", "ddm1")) %>%
  group_by(ID, Variant) %>% # Group by both TE and genotype
  group_map(~ {
    df <- .x
    te_id <- .y$ID
    geno_id <- .y$Variant
    model <- lmer(log2_TPM ~ (1|acc_var) + (1|Replicate), data = df)
    varcomp <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(model))
    var_acc <- varcomp$vcov[varcomp$grp == "acc_var"]
    var_replicate <- varcomp$vcov[varcomp$grp == "Replicate"]
    var_resid <- varcomp$vcov[varcomp$grp == "Residual"]
    h2 <- var_acc / (var_acc + var_replicate + var_resid)
    resids <- residuals(model)
    tibble(
      TE = te_id,
      genotype = geno_id,
      heritability = h2,
      var_acc = var_acc,
      var_replicate = var_replicate,
      var_resid = var_resid,
      residuals = resids
    )
  }) %>%
  bind_rows()

## Plot highly heritable TEs
family_annotation <- fread("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/11_resources/ref_genome/TAIR10_Transposable_Elements.txt")
long_data_step5_filtered_with_annotation <- inner_join(long_data_step5,family_annotation, by=c("TE"="Transposon_Name"))

heritability_with_family <- inner_join(family_annotation,heritability, by=c("Transposon_Name"="TE"))
  
ggplot(heritability, aes(x = heritability, fill = genotype)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#FFB823", "darkblue")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
  labs(title = "Heritability per TE", x = "Heritability", y = "Count") + 
  facet_wrap(~genotype)

## Residuals distribution 
ggplot(heritability, aes(x = residuals, fill = genotype)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#FFB823", "darkblue")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
  labs(title = "Residuals from heritability", x = "Heritability", y = "Count") + 
  facet_wrap(~genotype)
```


```{r}
heritability_with_family_ordered <- heritability_with_family[order(genotype, Transposon_Super_Family, -heritability)]

heritability_with_family_ordered <- heritability_with_family %>%
  group_by(genotype, Transposon_Super_Family) %>%
  arrange(genotype, Transposon_Super_Family, desc(heritability)) %>%
  mutate(Transposon_Name_ord = factor(Transposon_Name, 
                                     levels = unique(Transposon_Name))) %>%
  ungroup()

# Create a unique identifier for each TE within each facet group
heritability_with_family_ordered <- heritability_with_family %>%
  arrange(genotype, Transposon_Super_Family, desc(heritability)) %>%
  group_by(genotype, Transposon_Super_Family) %>%
  mutate(
    facet_id = paste(genotype, Transposon_Super_Family, sep = "_"),
    te_with_facet = paste(Transposon_Name, facet_id, sep = "___"),
    order_within_facet = row_number()
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    te_with_facet_ord = reorder(te_with_facet, -order_within_facet)
  )

# Plot with custom y-axis labels
heritability_with_family_ordered %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = heritability, y = te_with_facet_ord)) +
  geom_point() + 
  facet_wrap(~ genotype + Transposon_Super_Family, nrow = 2, scales = "free") +
  labs(x = "Heritability", y = "") + 
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
## Calculate BLUPs for each accession, each TE
```{r}
library(lme4)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

heritability_blups <- expression_cleaned_tes_maternal_filtered %>%
  filter(Variant %in% c("Col", "ddm1")) %>%
  group_by(ID, Variant) %>%
  group_map(~ {
    df <- .x
    te_id <- .y$ID
    geno_id <- .y$Variant
    
    # Fit mixed model
    model <- lmer(log2_TPM ~ (1|acc_var) + (1|Replicate), data = df)
    
    # Extract variance components
    varcomp <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(model))
    var_acc <- varcomp$vcov[varcomp$grp == "acc_var"]
    var_replicate <- varcomp$vcov[varcomp$grp == "Replicate"]
    var_resid <- varcomp$vcov[varcomp$grp == "Residual"]
    
    # Calculate heritability
    h2 <- var_acc / (var_acc + var_replicate + var_resid)
    # Extract BLUPs
    blups <- ranef(model)$acc_var
    fixed_effect <- fixef(model)
    # Get accession mapping
    acc_mapping <- df %>% select(acc_var, Accession) %>% distinct()
    # Create output
    tibble(
      acc_var = rownames(blups),
      BLUP = blups[, 1],
      predicted_log2_TPM = blups[, 1] + fixed_effect
    ) %>%
      left_join(acc_mapping, by = "acc_var") %>%
      mutate(
        TE = te_id,
        genotype = geno_id,
        heritability = h2,
        var_acc = var_acc,
        var_replicate = var_replicate,
        var_resid = var_resid
      )
  }) %>%
  bind_rows()

# Check the output
head(heritability_blups)
```

## Fitted VS residuals 
```{r}
# Extract fitted values and residuals
residual_check <- expression_cleaned_tes_maternal_filtered %>%
  filter(Variant %in% c("Col", "ddm1")) %>%
  group_by(ID, Variant) %>%
  group_map(~ {
    df <- .x
    model <- lmer(log2_TPM ~ (1|acc_var) + (1|Replicate), data = df)
    
    df %>%
      mutate(
        fitted = fitted(model),
        residual = residuals(model),
        TE = .y$ID,
        genotype = .y$Variant
      )
  }) %>%
  bind_rows()

# Plot fitted vs residuals
residual_check %>%
  filter(genotype == "ddm1") %>%
  ggplot(aes(fitted, residual)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE, color = "blue") +
  facet_wrap(~TE, scales = "free") +
  labs(
    x = "Fitted values",
    y = "Residuals",
    title = "Fitted vs Residuals - Should NOT show patterns"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
# Calculate observed means per accession
observed_means <- expression_cleaned_tes_maternal_filtered %>%
  filter(Variant %in% c("Col", "ddm1")) %>%
  group_by(ID, Variant, acc_var, Accession) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_log2_TPM = mean(log2_TPM, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_obs = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Join BLUPs with observed means
comparison <- heritability_blups %>%
  left_join(observed_means, 
            by = c("TE" = "ID", "genotype" = "Variant", "acc_var", "Accession"))

# Plot: BLUPs vs observed means
comparison %>%
  ggplot(aes(mean_log2_TPM, predicted_log2_TPM, color = n_obs)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  scale_color_viridis_c() +
  facet_wrap(~genotype) +
  labs(
    x = "Observed mean log2(TPM)",
    y = "BLUP predicted log2(TPM)",
    title = "BLUPs vs Observed Means",
    subtitle = "Points should be near diagonal; more shrinkage with fewer observations",
    color = "# obs"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1)

# Calculate correlation
comparison %>%
  group_by(genotype) %>%
  summarise(
    correlation = cor(mean_log2_TPM, predicted_log2_TPM, use = "complete.obs"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```
## Create phenotype for GWAS
```{r}
gwas_individual_tes <- heritability_blups %>% select(BLUP,Accession,TE,genotype, heritability)
## Create a genotype for Col and ddm1 
gwas_individual_tes_wide <- gwas_individual_tes %>%
  select(Accession, TE, genotype, BLUP,heritability) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = genotype,
    values_from = c(BLUP, heritability),
    names_prefix = ""
  )

head(gwas_individual_tes_wide)
## Filter low heritabilty TE 

filtered_by_heritability <- gwas_individual_tes_wide[gwas_individual_tes_wide$heritability_Col>=0.1 | gwas_individual_tes_wide$heritability_ddm1>=0.1,]

# Count TEs per variant
filtered_by_heritability %>%
  summarise(
    n_TEs_Col = sum(!is.na(BLUP_Col)),
    n_TEs_ddm1 = sum(!is.na(BLUP_ddm1)),
    n_unique_TEs_Col = n_distinct(TE[!is.na(BLUP_Col)]),
    n_unique_TEs_ddm1 = n_distinct(TE[!is.na(BLUP_ddm1)])
  )

blups_wide <- filtered_by_heritability
```
## Write GWAS dataframe 
```{r}
## Make accession numeric 
blups_wide$Accession <- as.numeric(blups_wide$Accession)
## Remove accessions from Tom's list
accessions_not_distingquished <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/common_data/fernandos_SNP_calls/heterozygous_accessions.txt")
#samples that doesnt exisit in the file plus 9981 which behaves wierd 
long_df_final <- blups_wide[!blups_wide$Accession %in% accessions_not_distingquished$V1, ]
long_df_final$null1<-'0'
long_df_final$null2<-'0'
long_df_final$null3<-'0'
long_df_final$null4<-'0'
## Form final df 
long_df_final <- long_df_final %>% dplyr::select(null1,Accession,null2,null3,null4,BLUP_Col,BLUP_ddm1,TE)
# Loop through each TE and write to its own folder
unique_TEs <- unique(long_df_final$TE)
## Indicate path 
base_path <- "/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/006_gwas/all_plates_96w/gemma_gwas/maternally_expressed_tes_61_longread_acc/ind_tes"
long_df_final <- long_df_final %>% ungroup()

for (te in unique_TEs) {
  te_df <- long_df_final %>%
    dplyr::filter(te == TE) %>%
    dplyr::select(null1, Accession, null2, null3, null4,BLUP_Col,BLUP_ddm1)
  # Create full path for TE
  te_dir <- file.path(base_path, te)
  dir.create(te_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  
  # Write the file inside the TE folder
  write.table(te_df,
              file = file.path(te_dir, "1163g.179kB.prior15.gauss4.ts99.5.BIALLELIC.selected.fam"),
              quote = FALSE,
              sep = "\t",
              row.names = FALSE,
              col.names = FALSE)}
```
